description: The operator's configuration of a Loam OS host: everything a caller may ask for. A caller chooses among these names and can add none. Semantic rules a schema cannot state (references between entries, capacity bounds, the runtime answering) are the plugin's own check in workspace-doctor (plugins.config_checks)

runtime.description: The container runtime the host drives through its command line

kind.description: Which runtime's command line it speaks; both take the same arguments for what the host runs

command.description: The runtime's program, a name looked up on PATH or an absolute path. Defaults to the kind's name

timeout_ms.description: How long one call to the runtime may take before the host treats it as unreachable

images.description: Session images by name. Each is pinned by digest and used only after pnpm verify --all on the base branch has passed in it

reference.description: The image by digest: <name>@sha256:<64 hex>, never a tag alone

toolchain.description: The tool versions the image carries, by tool name, as host-status lists them for a lane to check a branch's pins against

sizes.description: Machine sizes by name: processors, memory and disk

policies.description: Network policies by name: the hosts the proxy lets a step reach. A policy with no hosts is no network at all

repositories.description: Repositories by name: where their commits come from, their base branch and the image and size their machines use

source.description: Where the host fetches commits from into its own mirror: in M1 the lane's own repository on the same computer

size.description: The size a machine gets when the caller names none: a name under sizes

checkpoint_steps.description: The steps a checkpoint is made from (M2), by label

machines.description: The most machines alive at once: a lane needs its slots plus one for a cell's own runs

disk_gb.description: The disk the host's machines may use in all

min_free_disk_gb.description: Below this much free disk the host refuses a new machine with HOST_FULL
